result.topic_en: Expressions for the sine integral and the integral of (1-cos u)/u in terms of auxiliary integrals r cos θ and r sin θ, and the successive maxima and minima of the sine integral.
result.transcription:
If $r\cos\theta = \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-xt}}{1+t^2}\,dt$ \quad Add Ms a 94$^{18(6)}$ \quad (6)
and $r\sin\theta = \int_0^\infty \frac{t e^{-xt}}{1+t^2}\,dt$
so that $r^2 = \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-xt}}{t}\log(1+t^2)\,dt$
then $\int_0^x \frac{\sin u}{u}\,du = \frac{\pi}{2} - r\cos(x-\theta)$
and $\int_0^x \frac{1-\cos u}{u}\,du = \gamma + \log x - r\sin(x-\theta)$.
1st max value of $\int_0^x \frac{\sin u}{u}\,du = \frac{\pi}{2} + \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-\pi t}}{1+t^2}\,dt$
1st min -- -- do ———— $= \frac{\pi}{2} - \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-2\pi t}}{1+t^2}\,dt$
2nd max -- -- ———— -- -- $= \frac{\pi}{2} + \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-3\pi t}}{1+t^2}\,dt$
and so on.

methods.what: Definition of auxiliary functions (Laplace-transform representations of f and g for the sine/cosine integrals) in polar form
Integral representation of r^2 (modulus squared of auxiliary functions)
Sine integral Si(x) expressed via auxiliary functions in amplitude-phase form
Cosine integral Cin(x) = γ + log x − Ci(x) expressed via auxiliary functions
Extreme values of Si(x) at x = nπ given by π/2 ± ∫ e^{-nπt}/(1+t^2) dt

then $\int_0^x \frac{\sin u}{u}\,du = \frac{\pi}{2} - r\cos(x-\theta)$
and $\int_0^x \frac{1-\cos u}{u}\,du = \gamma + \log x - r\sin(x-\theta)$.
items.english: Then the integral from 0 to x of sin u/u equals π/2 − r cos(x−θ), and the integral from 0 to x of (1−cos u)/u equals γ + log x − r sin(x−θ).

1st max value of $\int_0^x \frac{\sin u}{u}\,du = \frac{\pi}{2} + \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-\pi t}}{1+t^2}\,dt$
1st min -- -- do ———— $= \frac{\pi}{2} - \int_0^\infty \frac{e^{-2\pi t}}{1+t^2}\,dt$

items.english: The first maximum value of the sine integral is π/2 plus the integral of e^{-πt}/(1+t²); the first minimum is π/2 minus the integral of e^{-2πt}/(1+t²); the second maximum is π/2 plus the integral of e^{-3πt}/(1+t²); and so on.
